ProjectileBounce.Description: Projectiles bounce twice, dealing {{CustomTooltip|+10%|Past Level 3: +3% per level}} damage each time, stacking with itself (Alterattack excluded).

ProjectilePierce.Description: Projectiles pierce and deal {{CustomTooltip|+20%|Past Level 3: +5% per level}} after the first target.

BurnDmg.Description: Damage {{CustomTooltip|+40%|Past Level 3: +10% per level}} to targets with {{EffectLink|Burn}}.

BleedDmg.Description: Damage {{CustomTooltip|+40%|Past Level 3: +10% per level}} to targets with {{EffectLink|Bleed}}.

RootDmg.Description: Damage {{CustomTooltip|+60%|Past Level 3: +15% per level}} to targets with {{EffectLink|Goo}}.

CumulativeHitDmg.Description: Each hit against the same target adds {{CustomTooltip|+10%|Past Level 3: +3% per level}} damage.

KillPermDmg.Description: Kills have a 5% chance to add {{CustomTooltip|+10%|Past Level 3: +3% per level}} permanent damage to this gear (Currently: +x%).

HitBurn.Description: Applies ''x'' {{EffectLink|Burn}} ({{CustomTooltip|+2|Past Level 3: +0.8 per level}} damage each).

HitBleed.Description: Applies ''x'' {{EffectLink|Bleed}} ({{CustomTooltip|1|Past Level 3: +0.4 per level}} bonus damage).

HitBlast.Description: Hits create a {{EffectLink|Blast}} that deals 10% of its damage to the target and 30% to those behind it.

AlterattackDmg.Description: Weapon's {{EffectLink|Alterattack}} deals {{CustomTooltip|+60%|Past Level 3: +15% per level}} damage.

CritDmgTradeDmg.Description: {{EffectLink|Criticals|Critical}} damage {{CustomTooltip|+80%|Past Level 3: +32% per level}}, but all other {{EffectLink|total damage}} -40%.

FinisherDmg.Description: Combo finisher damage {{CustomTooltip|+60%|Past Level 3: +15% per level}}.

FinisherBrutality.Description: Combo finisher activates {{EffectLink|Brutality}} for 4s ({{CustomTooltip|+60%|Past Level 3: +15% per level}}).

ChargeAtkAlterattack.Description: Held attacks hits launch an {{EffectLink|Alterattack}} signal (Cooldown: 7s).

FullCharge.Description: Damage {{CustomTooltip|+60%|Past Level 3: +15% per level}} if held longer.

CorrosivePoolLong.Description: Creates a {{EffectLink|Corrosive Pool}} for ''x''s ({{CustomTooltip|15|Past Level 3: +6 per level}} damage).

ScytheTrinket.Description: Spawns a {{EffectLink|Scythe}} for ''x''s ({{CustomTooltip|10|Past Level 3: +4 per level}} damage).

BeatboltAutoCrit.Description: Perfect timing is handled automatically, but {{EffectLink|total damage}} -20%.

KunaisReapplyCurse.Description: Reapplies half of the {{EffectLink|Curse|Curses}} that exploded.

RavebladeOpportunity.Description: If the held jump hits, gain an {{EffectLink|Opportunity}} to launch a stronger one.

AreaPetStrengthDecreaseCD.Description: Damage does not decay while not hitting a target.

KatarsBackDashNextCritical.Description: Held attacks make your next attack deal {{EffectLink|Criticals}}.

GearDeflectBrutality.Description: Block and {{EffectLink|Parry}} gives {{EffectLink|Brutality}} for 4s ({{CustomTooltip|+60%|Past Level 3: +15% per level}}).

GearDeflectEspadon.Description: Block and {{EffectLink|Parry}} creates an ethereal blade ({{CustomTooltip|100|Past Level 3: +25 per level}} damage).

HitVampirism.Description: Heals you for 1% of {{EffectLink|base damage}} dealt (while under 50% HP).

HealHexRare.Description: Heals you for 1% of {{EffectLink|base damage}} dealt, but damage taken +100%.

DmgHexRare.Description: Damage {{CustomTooltip|+100%|Past Level 3: +25% per level}}, but damage taken +100%.

ProjectileHitCorrosivePoolRare.Description: Projectiles hits create a {{EffectLink|Corrosive Pool}} for 1s ({{CustomTooltip|15|Past Level 3: +6 per level}} damage).
